nodes.label: ML-KEM-512 Module-Lattice Key Encapsulation Mechanism
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 203 Category 1 post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism parameter set providing AES-128 equivalent security based on Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) hard problems.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Port-Based Routing (PBR) Fabric Mechanism
nodes.description: CXL 3.1 memory fabric routing protocol replacing address-based routing with explicit port IDs to scale memory disaggregation across non-hierarchical multi-switch topologies.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Automatic Arabic Diacritization (Tashkeel) Subsystem
nodes.description: Neural and morphological diacritization pipeline in CAMeL Tools restoring missing short vowels and gemination marks (Tashkeel) for disambiguating Arabic text.

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 EL Profile Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a profile of OWL 2 tailored for ontologies with large numbers of reasoning classes and properties, offering polynomial-time reasoning complexity.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Masked Triangle Counting Algorithm Kernel
nodes.description: Algebraic graph algorithm computing local and global clustering coefficients via element-wise masked matrix multiplication L <L> * L' over the Plus-Pair semiring.
